title: [Bug]: CPU KV-Offloading CUDA Graph capture hang
author: varun-sundar-rabindranath

comments.author: varun-sundar-rabindranath
comments.body:
Hi @orozery @Acaciasama 

I believe there is a race between `_pin_cpu_tensors` and CUDA graph captures. 
I can make this work by calling  self.pin_thread.join() immediately after  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9036c89ee410b30913ca8b7d362a7d0805583b51/vllm/v1/kv_offload/cpu/gpu_worker.py#L525 (effectively making the pinning sequential).  Can you please take a look. Thanks 🙌

comments.author: orozery
comments.body:
Thanks @varun-sundar-rabindranath !
I'm good with the fix you suggested as a band-aid.
I think the proper solution (where we don't lose the async pinning feature) would be to gradually pin all tensors interleaved (and not one by one).
And have some kind of gradual events that we can wait-on on submit_load/submit_store, to assure that the blocks we are about to access are pinned.

comments.author: varun-sundar-rabindranath
comments.body: Hi @orozery  I added a PR to disable pinning for now. But I'd suggest reverting https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/45850 instead. wdyt ?

comments.author: orozery
comments.body:
> Hi [@orozery](https://github.com/orozery) I added a PR to disable pinning for now. But I'd suggest reverting [#45850](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/45850) instead. wdyt ?

Also works for me.

comments.author: Acaciasama
comments.body:
Hi @varun-sundar-rabindranath @orozery , I'm okay with reverting #45850 .

I also noticed that the `cudaHostRegister` failure returns `cudaErrorStreamCaptureUnsupported = 900`, which means "The operation is not permitted when the stream is capturing." This may imply that async pinning needs to finish before CUDA graph capture starts, or at least avoid overlapping with the capture window.

Do you have any suggestions on how I improve this feature going forward? Thanks!

comments.author: varun-sundar-rabindranath
comments.body:
put up a revert PR https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/46958 . Closed the band-aid PR. 
@orozery @Acaciasama  PTAL 🙌  Thanks.
